tex_content.html:
The flow $(M,g(t)),\ 0\le t<T$, where $g(t)=\sigma (t)\varphi _t^*g(0)$, is a soliton. It is a shrinking soliton if $\lambda >0$. \end{claim}

Proof

\sketch Verify the Ricci flow equation: that, the result follows immediately. We have

\frac{\partial g(t)}{\partial t}

=

σ’(t)ϕt*g(0)+σ(t)ϕt*LY(t)g(0)

=

ϕt*(-2λ+LX)g(0)

=

ϕt*(-2\Ric (g(0))) =-2\Ric (ϕt*(g(0))).

Since $\Ric (\alpha g)=\Ric (g)$ for any $\alpha >0$, it follows that

\[ \frac{\partial g(t)}{\partial t} = -2\Ric (g(t)). \]

□
